cases.observations: Opened independent editable copies from the built-in Graph Gallery, using the same definitions as the test pack examples. On Two slopes, repeated taps at the crossing cycled from Unit slope: x=-0.997273, y=-0.997273 to Steeper line: x=-1.00083, y=-1.00166; an empty tap cleared the probe. On A rolling circle's trace, the Cycloid readout included x=3.18461, y=1.99977, parameter=3.16310. On A three-petal rose, the Rose readout included x=0.865045, y=0.501662, parameter=3.66712 (signed-radius branch). On Implicit conics, Circle read x=0.0217392, y=0.972222 and Hyperbola read x=1.00000, y=0.0483092. On Endpoints and missing data, a measured point read x=1.00000, y=0.500000, row_4; tapping the empty x=0,y=0 gap cleared the probe.
